categories.main_business_segments: Shanghai United Imaging Healthcare Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the development, manufacturing, and sales of high-end medical imaging diagnostic equipment and radiation therapy devices. Its product portfolio includes Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI), Computed Tomography (CT), X-ray imaging systems (XR), Molecular Imaging (PET/CT, PET/MR), Radiation Therapy (RT) equipment, and life science instruments. The company also provides maintenance services and develops medical imaging software and digital healthcare solutions.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company has proprietary core technologies in superconducting magnets, high-performance gradient coils, digital RF power amplifiers, and distributed spectrometers for MRI systems. It develops advanced CT detectors, X-ray tubes, and high-voltage generators with AI-enabled low-dose imaging algorithms. Molecular imaging technologies include digital silicon photomultiplier (SiPM) PET detectors and advanced image reconstruction algorithms. Radiation therapy products feature integrated CT-guided linear accelerators with precise dose control and adaptive treatment planning. Production is carried out in Shanghai, Changzhou, Wuhan, and Houston with intelligent manufacturing and quality management systems.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers are hospitals, medical research institutions, and universities, including over 1,000 top-tier hospitals in China. The company serves clinical and research applications in oncology, neurology, cardiology, and other medical fields. It also targets emerging markets and developed countries globally, providing solutions for diagnostic imaging, radiation therapy, and life sciences research. The company supports healthcare providers in China’s tiered medical system and international markets across Asia, Europe, the Americas, and Africa.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with extensive domestic market penetration. It has expanded its global footprint with subsidiaries and sales networks in over 65 countries across Asia, North America, Europe, Oceania, Africa, and Latin America. Key overseas markets include the United States, Europe (UK, France, Spain, Italy), India, Southeast Asia, and emerging markets along the Belt and Road Initiative. Production bases are located in China and the United States.
categories.supply_chain_position: United Imaging Healthcare operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the medical equipment supply chain. It designs, manufactures, and assembles complete medical imaging and radiation therapy systems, including core components and subsystems. The company also provides after-sales services and software solutions, integrating upstream technologies with end-user clinical applications.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes innovation-driven growth with a focus on original technology breakthroughs, core component self-development, and integration of AI, 5G, and IoT technologies. It pursues multi-modal, cross-scale imaging and therapy solutions, advancing precision, digital intelligence, accessibility, integrated diagnosis and treatment, and low-carbon technologies. R&D efforts include expanding patent portfolios, developing next-generation products like total-body PET/CT, ultra-high field MRI, and integrated CT-guided radiotherapy accelerators. It fosters global academic and clinical collaborations to accelerate translational medicine and talent development.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of medical imaging and radiation therapy equipment, including MRI, CT, XR, PET/CT, PET/MR, and RT systems. Additional revenue streams include maintenance and repair services, software licensing, and digital healthcare solutions. The company employs both direct sales and distributor channels domestically and internationally. It also benefits from government subsidies and investment income.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: United Imaging Healthcare is a leading domestic player in China’s high-end medical imaging and radiation therapy market, competing with global giants such as GE Healthcare, Siemens Healthineers, Philips Healthcare, Varian, and Elekta. It holds top market shares in PET/CT and PET/MR in China and ranks among the top three in CT and MRI equipment. The company is recognized for its innovation and is increasingly expanding its presence in international markets, positioning itself as a global competitor in advanced medical imaging and therapy equipment.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 11.41 billion, representing a 23.52% year-over-year increase. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 1.97 billion, up 19.21%. Total assets reached RMB 25.34 billion, with equity attributable to shareholders at RMB 18.87 billion. The company maintains a robust R&D investment ratio of 16.81% of revenue, reflecting strong growth and commitment to innovation. Its global business and overseas revenue have shown rapid expansion, with overseas revenue accounting for 14.7% of total revenue.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: United Imaging Healthcare differentiates itself through comprehensive product lines covering diagnostic imaging and radiation therapy with industry-leading performance and innovation. It offers integrated, AI-enabled, multi-modal imaging and therapy solutions that enhance diagnostic accuracy and treatment precision. The company emphasizes proprietary core technologies, extensive patent portfolios, and a vertically integrated R&D and manufacturing system. Its global service network and collaborative innovation ecosystem with top medical institutions further strengthen its competitive edge, delivering high-quality, accessible, and sustainable healthcare solutions.
